title: Product approval, release and suspension controls
workflow: Submit reviewed product edition and risk assessment
Validate financial mapping and product eligibility dependencies
Collect legal/CFO/compliance approvals with non-self-approval checks
Prepare release rollback and change notification
Activate only approved effective-dated product edition
Suspend future intake if authority expires without modifying past contracts
invariants: Approval cannot be inferred from a ZIP checkpoint or deployment
Bank product regulation may differ by institution and license type
No single proposer can grant final financial product activation
Unreviewed fees/rates cannot post to ledger
Suspension stops new issuance without rewriting historical agreements
Every decision is reproducible from evidence and approved version
planned_tests: Old contract remains intact after suspension
Duplicate approval command cannot double activate
approval_gate: Actual institutional product committee, applicable regulatory evidence and finance/risk approval.
